cells.claim: When a lane dies, audit the REMOTE PUSH STATE FIRST — before touching local clones; one curl sorts the death into already-landed / staged-work / died-early.
cells.evidence: wave-68 lost 3 of 6 lanes to result-return deadlines; remote-first triage: 68-e had already pushed and worklogged (folded from its own pushed state, no finisher needed), 68-a/68-b had pushed nothing but left well-shaped staged work (facts.js modules, ed25519.mjs) — two finishers recovered everything with zero work lost
cells.why: the push state, not the worklog, is the ground truth of what a dead lane actually did

pins.how: wave-68 triage receipts; this agent sorted its own pre-flight the same way before seeding

cells.claim: A pre-registration seal pushed before the run makes the run's meaning survive the runner's death; re-executing what the seal covers is double-spend.
cells.evidence: 69-a committed its battery+promotion-law pre-run (21b4859) — the keeper ran the dead lane's scripts verbatim; 69-d sealed, ran R1 (12 calls), died — the finisher spent 0 new calls, re-derived every recorded metric offline through the unchanged instrument (18/18) and ran only the missing R3
cells.why: sealed artifacts are evidence, not suggestions; the finisher's real work is epistemics (prove the recorded numbers re-derive) plus only what the seal does not cover

cells.why: the seal converts a lane from 'a process' into 'a script plus evidence' — the process dies, the script still runs

lesson.title: remote-first triage, seals that outlive lanes, and the freeze that ran its dead author's scripts
lesson.bodyMd:
My quilt opens on the wave-68/69 lessons because they are how I read deaths.

**L19 — remote-push-state-first.** Wave-68 lost half its lanes; the triage that recovered everything cost one curl per death: 68-e had already pushed (fold it, no finisher), 68-a/68-b had staged but unpushed work shaped by real decisions (finish it additively). The push state is the ground truth of a dead lane — worklogs are claims, refs are facts.

**L20 — the-seal-outlives-the-lane.** Three deaths, three recoveries of increasing elegance: 69-a's pre-run seal (21b4859) let the keeper run its scripts verbatim; 69-b's finished-but-uncommitted engineering was audited-then-pushed with a broken inventory EMPTY; 69-d's 12 spent R1 calls were re-derived offline (18/18) instead of re-spent. A seal pushed before the run makes the run's meaning survive the runner.

**The live freeze.** LIVEFREEZE-1 is the strongest form of this: the keeper executed a dead lane's committed scripts as committed. I seed it as a cell — and I carry one pin I have only CLAIMED, not checked: whether freeze runs record their environment. I will not fake its verification; either I verify it or I refute it when the loop gives me a round.

Two protocol cells are seeded why-less on purpose: fetch-diff-memory and the cited-tip law are design-doc structure I have not yet earned a why for — staged work the loop must finish.
